title: Quotient Hom cohomology comparison for two fixed constant perfect models
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring in the coefficient universe, J an ideal and U a coefficient-sized pro-etale site object. Assume epimorphisms of set sheaves on the slice over U evaluate surjectively at its terminal object [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. Let P and Q be bounded integer cochain complexes of finite-projective A-modules. Let T,N be their completed constant realizations restricted to U, and R_n the actual derived coefficient reductions. There are bijections e_n: Hom(R_n(T),R_n(N)) -> F_n, where F is the quotient algebraic Hom cohomology tower [def-sfb-adic-perfect-hom-cohomology-tower]. These intertwine every actual successor Hom transition with the successor transition of F, including the prescribed scalar-reassociation conjugations. There is no Noetherian, affine or completeness hypothesis, and no varying object M or stabilization conclusion.

proof.text: Use adicPerfectReductionModels separately on P and Q. This supplies K-projective ordinary quotient source complexes and isomorphisms rP_n,rQ_n computing actual reductions, with their counit/scalar-balancing squares.

K-projective localization is bijective on Hom out of each source model. Compose Qh.map with the quotientCompQhIso Hom conjugation and rP_n,rQ_n conjugations to obtain bijections k_n from ordinary homotopy-category Hom to the actual derived Hom sets. On a chain map f, k_n sends its homotopy class to rP_n.hom followed by Q(f) followed by rQ_n.inv. Compose k_n inverse with the ordinary Hom/cohomology bijection of adicPerfectModelHomCohomology.

Represent an arbitrary derived successor-level map by a homotopy class using k_(n+1), and lift that class to an actual chain map using fullness of the homotopy quotient. The two object-computation squares and naturality of extendComparison show that its actual successor map is k_n of alpha_P.inv followed by ordinary scalar extension of f followed by alpha_Q.hom. This is the proved categorical reduction_conjugation calculation. Apply the ordinary successor equality and cancel the inverse bijections.

theorem adicPerfectHomCohomologyComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A]
    (J : Ideal A) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (_hU : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) ℤ)
    (a b c d : ℤ) (_ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (_hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (_hc : Q.IsStrictlyGE c) (_hd : Q.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (_hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X i))
    (_hQ : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (Q.X i) ∧ Module.Projective A (Q.X i)) :
    let T := (adicResidueRestriction
      (ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J) U).obj
        (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, v} X J P)
    let N := (adicResidueRestriction
      (ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J) U).obj
        (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, v} X J Q)
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, (adicResidueHomTower X J U T N).obj (op n) ≃
        (adicPerfectHomCohomologyTower X J U P Q).obj (op n),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : (adicResidueHomTower X J U T N).obj (op (n + 1))),
        e n (adicResidueHomStep X J U T N n x) =
          (adicPerfectHomCohomologyTower X J U P Q).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op (e (n + 1) x)
